scope: Sprint 10 Phase 11 — security tests for the new v2/v1 cross-state comparison interfaces (migration 016)

tests.name: anon_can_execute_search_market_geographies_v2
tests.method: SET ROLE anon; SELECT ... FROM public.search_market_geographies_v2(...)
tests.detail: anon successfully executed the RPC and received 5 VIC/Melbourne matches

tests.name: row_limit_clamp_enforced
tests.detail: requested limit 999 was clamped to 50 inside the function (LEAST/GREATEST), returning exactly 50 rows — cannot be bypassed by caller-supplied limit

tests.name: compare_row_count_enforced
tests.detail: call with 1 geography_id correctly raised P0001 'supports 2-5 geographies, got 1' and returned no rows

tests.name: sql_injection_probe
tests.detail: payload treated as a literal parameter value (0 matching rows returned), no secondary statement executed — PL/pgSQL parameter binding, not string concatenation

tests.name: anon_denied_direct_mart_select
tests.method: SET ROLE anon; SELECT count(*) FROM mart.suburb_market_snapshot
tests.detail: permission denied for schema mart (42501) — no direct grant exists, confirming the only path to mart data is through the SECURITY DEFINER functions

tests.name: anon_denied_mart_write
tests.method: SET ROLE anon; UPDATE mart.suburb_market_snapshot SET jurisdiction='VIC' WHERE ...
tests.detail: permission denied for schema mart (42501) — write attempt fails identically to read attempt

tests.name: anon_denied_meta_jurisdiction_direct_access
tests.method: SET ROLE anon; SELECT count(*) FROM meta.jurisdiction
tests.detail: permission denied for schema meta (42501) — explicit REVOKE in migration 016 confirmed effective; jurisdiction lookup is only reachable via the SECURITY DEFINER search function

not_tested_this_pass: PostgREST-layer anon key end-to-end request (tested at the SQL role level via SET ROLE anon, which exercises the same GRANT/REVOKE state PostgREST relies on, but does not exercise the HTTP/PostgREST routing layer itself)
